source_qa: Reconstruct Smith analytic outputs only for source QA; compare independent vH steady anchors for units/RHS only, tau cancels at steady state.
source_replay_boundary: Original vH PDF/erratum and unrelated global registry assets are missing locally. This isolated branch reconstructs the exact existing source profile and records from sources/core_registry.json, checks all22 values and units against the locked NativeConeH1 transcription, pins registry/source code hashes and checks supplied canonical independent anchors. It does not invoke or pass global registry admission, does not certify missing primary assets, and never registers a derived candidate as a source profile.

spatial_check.H1_selection: Before optimization: singleton H1 nearest4.73deg,0 using its A-weighted incoming cone RF centroids; never HC soma. Engineering selection, not a Smith cell registration.
spatial_check.requirement: Complete original fine A/B and member RF/IS support, background L0; do not crop/renormalize or equate eccentricity4.73deg with diameter5deg.

claim_limits: No absolute native-to-mV gain calibration, macaque measurement, eccentricity match, H2 calibration or production spatial validation. Candidate stays opt-in; adoption would invalidate downstream caches and require BC/AC/RGC revalidation; old RGC input-clamp scores cannot validate changed HC.
